name: Erica
source:
Jen's tall and spaced out roommate, Erica is a newly out trans girl who was behind Girl Dracula's summoning. Always easy-going, she doesn't mind going along with whatever the vampire demands of her. But how much longer will she wait for Girl Dracula to fulfill her promise?

[From [url=https://air-gong.itch.io/the-intern-of-christmas-present]Itch.io[/url]]
